reviews.title: Favorite App
reviews.text: I was genuinely skeptical at first. I saw this on TT and thought it was probably a scam, although it is a subscription which $30 for a whole year seems worth it to me. I genuinely have fallen in love with this app. I look forward to it every day. Consistency was the hardest part about committing to our weight loss journey, but this app makes it so much fun. I love that we have to snap a picture, kind of like a be real, and that my bf and I get to see it. I always look forward to seeing what he’s doing or his little comments he leaves under my pictures. I love that the app helps keep track of your weeks and highlights when you complete a week. I even set long-term goals. I was skeptical at first but has definitely became my favorite app and the most fun way to work out and keep track of me and my partner as we meet our goals. Also, I never review anything, and I had to leave one on this app that’s how you know I really enjoyed it 😭!

reviews.title: Do Not Downlod
reviews.text: Great concept, however upon opening you are bombarded with AI graphics which is the first bad sign. It then asks you to write a review before you even see any features the app offers which will cause false positive reviews. When you complete account set up it will then tell you that you cannot use ANY app features without paying $3.33/month or $40/year. FINALLY when I went to delete the app it showed a pop up for 50% off that I wouldn’t have known about and would’ve paid full price for an app devoid of any creativity as its basically just BeReal (WHICH IS FREE) but for two people. What a joke!

reviews.title: Back camera activated for selfie
reviews.text: It seemed like a pretty good app that my partner and I could try. We are just starting our fitness journey and was looking for something for a little motivation. We both agreed the app looked amazing but the only thing that we felt uncomfortable about is the double sided photo. We work out in the gym and the fact that we have to use the back camera as well for the selfie is a little uncomfortable. I really don’t want to capture someone working out and accuse us of inappropriately filming them. It really would be amazing if we are just able to use either the back or front camera. Or somehow a way to log in our work outs manually or have the location on if we’re at the gym or track our steps if we’re running, etc.

I was really excited to use this, but it just led to me quickly deleting the app after it demanded I pay.
